data.narrative:
Perennial Autonomy operates in the Defense & Security sector at the government contract stage, backed by Schmidt-family capital and a $500M IDIQ contract vehicle. The comparable universe includes 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, with top-tier private comparables including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Traditional peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here. The Defense & Security sector contains 23 same-sector peers, but filtering for stage-matched, adjacent-stage, or valuation-tier-similar companies yielded fewer than three datapoints—the minimum threshold for meaningful triangulation. Applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable distortion given the narrow applicability of defense and security-specific dynamics to other verticals.

Without sufficient same-stage private comparable data and given the highly customized nature of government contracts, a quantitative valuation range cannot be responsibly anchored. The key uncertainties are contract performance burn rate, revenue recognition timing under the IDIQ vehicle, and the absence of recent fundraising or exit precedent in this narrow subsegment. Future valuation work should revisit this analysis if additional Series C or D financing from comparable defense autonomy firms becomes available, or if Perennial achieves material revenue milestones under its government contract that permit revenue-multiple calibration against the identified public and private peer set.
